title: Ron Tototz in the surf at Nha Trang
description: Ron Tototz walks up the sand out of heavy churned surf at Nha Trang beach, near beach hut #3 or #4 — the hut run by two girls selling soda pop, beer, and shrimp. Larry attaches a darker memory to this stretch of water: a medic from Nebraska went out into it and disappeared.
larrysRecollection:
Ron Tototz walking on beach.
A medic died here that was from Nebraska, went out to the water and disappeared. Nha Trang beach hut #3 or #4 same location as the other picture on the beach hut. there were two girls running the beach hut that had soda pop, beer, shrimp
researchNotes: Larry's own account (Memories comment, 2026-08-15; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0021-c18032383.json). The drowned medic is a strongly findable person: a Nebraska medic lost to drowning at Nha Trang should appear in casualty databases (unresolved question #14) — non-hostile deaths are recorded with home state and cause. Confirms the survey's Nha Trang hypothesis for this beach series.
